description: ECDH-ES+A128KW on a secp256k1 and a P-256 key returns the P-256 key; decided by ADR 0054 §2.1 (family): ECDH-ES+A128KW is served by P-256, P-384, P-521 and X25519 keys, and secp256k1 never matches ECDH-ES (RFC 7518 §4.6 names the NIST curves); member 1 has no alg, use (U = enc) or key_ops, and the selector has no kid; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
